name: Sbu Collage

replaces.name: SCRL: Photo Collage Maker
replaces.price_model: freemium, auto-renewing SCRL Premium after a 7-day trial

one_thing: Sbu Collage puts your photos into one grid, in a few taps, and saves it to Photos as one image or as equal slices.

features.name: Pick photos
features.description: PhotosPicker, 2 to 20 photos, any format the system decodes (HEIC, HDR, ProRAW previews, screenshots). No library permission: the picker runs out of process and hands over only the chosen items.
features.reason: Every collage starts here; SCRL needs full or limited library access.

features.name: Layouts by photo count
features.description: Layouts generated from the number of photos (rows, columns, one large plus small), not a template library. The list only ever shows layouts that fit exactly the photos picked.
features.reason: SCRL's paid templates are the paywalled core; reviews also ask to filter templates by number of photos.

features.name: Arrange
features.description: Drag a photo onto another to swap, pinch and pan inside its cell, drag the divider between two cells to resize only those two.
features.reason: Core editing gesture of every collage tool.

features.name: Frame
features.description: Spacing and outer border with a slider, corner rounding, background colour from ColorPicker (default paper white).
features.reason: Paywalled in SCRL (backgrounds, borders); used in every export.

features.name: Canvas shape
features.description: Square 1:1, portrait 4:5, story 9:16, and wide: 2 to 10 portrait 4:5 slides side by side.
features.reason: SCRL Premium sells multi-frame canvases (more pages, more than 10 frames).

features.name: Save to Photos
features.description: Renders off screen at full resolution (long side up to 4096 px per slide) and adds the image to Photos with add-only permission, asked at the Save button. ShareLink for every other destination.
features.reason: The output the paying user exports; reviews show export is where SCRL fails.

features.name: Save as slices
features.description: A wide canvas is saved as N equal 4:5 images in order, numbered, ready for any multi-image post. No upper limit imposed by the app.
features.reason: What SCRL users pay for (more than 10 photos, continuous carousel). Offered as one export option, not as the app's identity (4.1).

features.name: Export that matches the editor
features.description: One renderer draws both the editor preview and the export, so borders, crops and colours are identical. If saving fails the reason is shown (space, permission) and the draft stays intact.
features.reason: Export or render failures and borders missing from the final image: 8 reviews.

features.name: Draft kept on crash
features.description: The current collage is autosaved after every change (layout, crop, spacing) and restored exactly at launch; one draft, no project gallery.
features.reason: Crashes, slowness and lost edits: 11 reviews (9 crash/slow, 2 edits lost or images moved after a crash).

features.name: Any photo imports
features.description: Images are loaded as data and downsampled with ImageIO; HDR and wide-gamut photos keep Display P3; unsupported items are named, not silently dropped.
features.reason: Photos that will not import, no HDR support: 2 reviews.

features.name: Three steps, nothing else
features.description: Pick, arrange, save. No onboarding, no account, no social login, no feed.
features.reason: Too complicated, login every time: 4 reviews.

features.name: Cut out a subject
features.description: Long-press a photo to lift its subject onto a transparent layer above the grid (Vision foreground instance mask, iOS 17, on device).
features.reason: Stickers from your own photos removed or paywalled, no object removal: 2 reviews. Object removal itself is skipped.

features.name: Save as PDF
features.description: Slices saved as one multi-page PDF through the share sheet.
features.reason: Asked in 1 review (it). Export format only; editing PDFs belongs to Sbu PDF.

features.name: Video in a cell
features.description: A short video plays in one cell and the collage exports as a video.
features.reason: Paywalled in SCRL, but AVFoundation composition and export roughly doubles the estimate; candidate for 1.1.

features.name: Text caption
features.description: One line of SF text on the canvas, Dynamic Type sizes.
features.reason: SCRL offers fonts and text; not needed for the one thing.

data_model.storage: One Codable JSON draft plus image copies in Application Support/Draft, written atomically after each change. No SwiftData: there is one draft, no history. Nothing in iCloud. Output goes to Photos only when the user saves.

monetization.model: Free download with SCRL Premium auto-renewing subscription (weekly, monthly, yearly) after a 7-day free trial
monetization.price: Not listed in the lookup; reviews cite about $50-$100 per year, 29 EUR per year, 5 EUR per week
paywalled_features: background removal / stickers from own photos (removed from free)
monetization.notes: Features that used to be free have moved behind Premium (17 of 59 low-star reviews); trial converts to annual without the promised reminder (6). Direct posting to Instagram and TikTok needs an account link.

skipped.feature: Direct posting to Instagram and TikTok
skipped.reason: Needs account linking and network; share sheet covers it.
Licensed decorative assets; design system forbids decorative elements.
Photos already does it; not the one thing.
Generative inpainting has no on-device public API on iOS 17.
Design rule against gradients; solid colour only.
Turns a grid tool into a design app; keeps the scope at 6 days.
No accounts or network; iCloud sync not needed for a single draft.

review_risks.risk: Collage makers are one of the most crowded Photo & Video niches, and the developer already had six 1.0s rejected under 4.3 on 14/10.
review_risks.mitigation: Ship alone, not in a lot; answer the nine Resolution Center questions in the review notes up front; state the difference: no library permission, no account, no templates to buy, export identical to the editor, slices with no cap.

review_risks.risk: SCRL's identity is the seamless carousel (one panorama scrolled across slides); copying its flow, wording ('seamless', 'carousel') or look invites 4.1.
review_risks.mitigation: The product is a grid collage; wide-to-slices is one export option. Generated layouts, own wording ('slices'), no SCRL screenshots or names in metadata (lesson of commit 909af97).

review_risks.risk: Shared SbuKit, same 'Sbu X' naming, same promise block, same icon grammar.
review_risks.mitigation: Review note 'How it differs from the other Sbu apps': only Sbu app that writes to Photos; Sbu Clean deletes from Photos, Sbu Docs scans paper. Distinct screenshots showing the editor.

review_risks.risk: Same shell and structure as other Sbu apps.
review_risks.mitigation: Distinct editor UI and gestures; review note on who wrote the code.

review_risks.risk: Requesting full library access for a collage would be rejected or flagged.
review_risks.mitigation: PhotosPicker needs no permission; add-only permission explained in NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription and asked only at 'Salva in Foto'; app works with it denied (ShareLink).

review_risks.risk: Privacy label must match: no data collected.
review_risks.mitigation: Data Not Collected; privacy manifest declares file timestamp / UserDefaults reasons only.
